scares.description: Dennis touches the ground and some images flash across the screen that may startle some people.
A flash of light and a high pitched noise startle Dennis (this occurs several more times throughout the movie).
Several ghosts appear in front of Dennis over the next 30 seconds or so.
Arthur touches Dennis and several images of burned people flash across the screen.
As The Angry Princess ghost goes to attack Kathy, Arthur knocks on the door.
The Bound Woman ghost appears behind Bobby.
Bobby turns around and sees Cyrus.
Dennis turns around and sees The Hammer ghost.
Kathy puts on the spectral glasses and sees The Jackal ghost.
Kathy sees The Jackal ghost at the door.
Arthur turns around and sees The Hammer ghost behind him.
Kalina appears, startling Dennis and Maggie.
A sudden cut from a quiet scene to Kalina holding a flare may startle some viewers.
As Dennis experiences more psychic flashes, The Jackal appears behind Arthur and attacks him.
The Torn Prince ghost appears in front of Arthur.
Cyrus looks up and all the ghosts are standing over him.
